race.comment: PRETTY MORSEL (7) ran a better race last start when she worked home well to finish a close third over 1200m at Strathalbyn. Strips fitter third-up and is ideally to finally get off the mark. FOMENTER (2) showed good tactical speed on debut but just tired late when sent out fav at Strathalbyn. Is sure to have come on from that and is drawn to advantage for Opperman. Big threat. ROAD TO THE CITY (5) went forward and gave a great sight before finishing third last time out at Port Augusta. Carries a fitness edge and is in the mix. PEYTON JANE (6) battled on soundly into fourth when resuming at Mt Gambier three weeks ago. Fitter now and is an each-way shot.
